audit: Full financial and durable-store functional audit
review_method: Read every owned runtime and test file body, including SQL schemas/migrations and nested fixtures.
Trace every public mutation, read snapshot, local simulation, native broker reconciliation, pending liability, signed cost-basis, protection/OCO, session and terminal lifecycle path.
Use isolated temporary SQLite databases, in-process broker/provider fixtures, concurrency tests, injected clocks and numerical boundary probes; no real broker network calls.
Repair confirmed defects directly and rerun the complete owned financial/legacy suite after each material group.

coverage.scope: entire file, including schema/migrations, constants, functions and nested fixtures

findings.title: Per-book caps ignored pending explicit prices and could discount held marks
findings.reproduction: A pending one-share short limit at $100 and a second one-share short market instruction were both admitted under a $150 cap; the shared projected exposure was $200. A cheap buy limit also discounted current held exposure.
findings.repair: _validate_capacity now combines current marks, explicit pending/candidate stop and limit bounds, signed pending quantities and all held symbols before applying book caps.

findings.title: Buy-stop cash reservation ignored its explicit trigger
findings.reproduction: A ten-share buy-stop at $30 was accepted with $100 cash using a $10 quote and reserved only $100 before potential broker transport.
findings.repair: Reserve pure buy-stops at at least their explicit trigger; preserve limit ceilings for stop-limit orders and retain known bounds after partial fills.

findings.title: Aggregate monetary arithmetic could overflow the exact cents ledger
findings.reproduction: Two allowed large short instructions caused a processing-pass OverflowError; SQLite addition can promote overflowed integer money to REAL. Manual extreme notionals were not range validated.
findings.repair: Validate signed 64-bit cents before funding/fill writes, cumulative money and valuation receipts. Assign checked totals instead of unchecked SQL arithmetic. Validate all possible fill-range errors before mutations so catching DeskError cannot commit a partial accounting effect; isolate an invalid intent while servicing healthy books. Independent local reconciliation also rejects pre-existing REAL/out-of-range monetary columns without resetting state.

findings.title: Broker receipts could be attributed to a different authorized asset or mechanics
findings.reproduction: A receipt with a matching client identity but MSFT symbol was recorded as an AAPL fill; mismatched side, broker ID, quantity or price/mechanics were also unchecked.
findings.repair: Validate broker/client identity, symbol, side, quantity, type, time in force and explicit prices before any accounting. Accept only decreasing native protective quantity adjustments; refuse increases and inconsistent filled status.

findings.title: Lagging broker status could reopen conclusively cancelled orders
findings.reproduction: After conclusive cancellation, a stale accepted order snapshot reset local status to open and introduced an unreserved active liability. Fully filled records could also become cancellation records.
findings.repair: Preserve terminal local status and completion timestamps against regressing lifecycle snapshots while still accounting newly measured cumulative fill deltas. Retain broker_status separately for source fidelity.

findings.title: Sub-cent broker partial fills were rejected and implied prices used rounded cents
findings.reproduction: A real 0.0001-share partial at $10 has positive execution quantity/value but rounds to zero ledger cents; it was rejected. Incremental prices derived from rounded cumulative cents could differ materially from the source-implied price. Orphan quantities over six decimal places were rejected despite supported nine-place broker precision.
findings.repair: Persist exact broker cumulative notional; derive positive incremental prices from exact cumulative source values; retain zero-cent positive-quantity partials exactly once; support observed nine-place broker quantities while operator input remains six-place.

findings.title: Manual ledger allowed historical daily marks to authorize intraday fills
findings.reproduction: The autonomous engine rejected source labels identifying daily historical marks, but the independent manual approval path accepted the same fresh-timestamped historical price.
findings.repair: Apply the same historical source gate to manual order creation and approval; preserve the pending order/cash when refused.

findings.title: Reconstruction chronology depended on wall-clock and lexical timezone ordering
findings.reproduction: Valid local fills 10@$10,10@$20,5@$25 produced $50 realized P&L, but a backward observed clock reordered reconstruction and falsely failed the book. Broker orphan source timestamps with different offsets sorted lexically rather than by actual time.
findings.repair: Reconstruct local cost basis in immutable append rowid order. Normalize broker source timestamps to UTC datetime before orphan cumulative replay.

findings.title: Broker snapshot observation timestamps preceded the provider reads
findings.reproduction: A slow complete reconciliation was labelled with the time before account/positions/orders/identity reads, causing newly obtained truth to appear stale and mislabelling observation provenance.
findings.repair: Refresh the production wall clock after successful complete network reads for each broker book; retain deterministic explicit clock injection.

findings.title: Changed broker cumulative notional without changed quantity was silently ignored
findings.reproduction: A previously measured one-share fill at $10 could later report $11 at the same quantity without rejecting the contradictory accounting receipt.
findings.repair: Reject a changed cent execution notional at unchanged cumulative quantity and preserve prior cash, fills and positions. Broker execution corrections require a separate verified correction workflow.

findings.title: Cumulative broker order chronology presented an unverified realized P&L as known
findings.reproduction: Actual sequence buy 1@$10, sell 1@$20, buy 1@$20 realizes $10, but aggregate buy order 2@$15 completes after the sell. Sorting order cumulative endpoints reconstructs $5 and previously exposed it as known account/position/fill/journal realized P&L despite source position cost $20 disagreeing with estimated ledger cost $15.
findings.repair: Conservatively withhold all broker realized P&L outputs with explicit execution-history coverage until a complete ordered broker execution activity tape and verified source basis are installed. Public fill realized_cents also becomes null. Keep internal reconstructed cents as explicitly unverified raw evidence. New broker journal events use null realized values and coverage. Average cost/basis/unrealized are known only against a matching complete broker position snapshot; durable receipt cursor prevents newer receipt estimates from being mistaken for verified position basis.

findings.title: Concurrent journal verification could overwrite a newer checkpoint or integrity failure
findings.reproduction: An older verifier scanned checkpoint 1, then paused before writing status. Another append/verifier advanced to checkpoint 2 or recorded a new failure; the older verifier could resume and overwrite the newer checkpoint/failure because scanning and publication used separate SQL transactions.
findings.repair: Serialize the full chain scan, checkpoint comparison and status publication in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. A later append/verification follows the older publication, so a stale successful scan cannot overwrite newer evidence or failure.

joint_repairs.behavior: Trading.process calls optional execution_fence(con) inside each per-intent write transaction, before local effects. Final broker pre-submit SQL guard also uses the callback; pause exceptions propagate without blocking an intent. Already returned or recovered broker receipts remain truthfully recorded.

limits: Inspection and focused regression coverage are not a formal proof that all possible bugs are absent.
Broker cumulative average prices provide implied incremental execution prices, not a complete broker trade-activity tape; source average rounding remains visible as a measurement limit.
Pre-migration broker fill prices cannot recover exact sub-cent source notional that was never retained; repeated existing cumulative receipts seed the new exact field when consistent.

Unexpected broker execution corrections, corporate-action repricing and increased/replaced protection require a verified repair workflow; this desk intentionally fails closed rather than inventing corrected money.

Broker requests in this audit are simulated. Actual account integration, unknown external fees/cashflows and generic broker cancel/replace protection repair remain deployment/extension limits already disclosed.

Broker realized_cents retained in raw SQL evidence are reconstruction estimates. Public broker account/position/fill views and new journal receipts explicitly withhold realized P&L; an ordered execution activity importer remains an uninstalled extension.
